Package com.felipe.belo.mvp.utils

Class I18nConstants

java.lang.Object
com.felipe.belo.mvp.utils.I18nConstants
public final class I18nConstants extends Object
Centralized i18n message keys used across the application.

These constants map to entries in src/main/resources/i18n/messages*.properties.
